text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday said modernising agriculture was a patriotic duty.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui on Monday reported to President Ben Ali on his mission to France last week. Karoui said that France as well as Tunisia aim at boosting bilateral relations.
- President Ben Ali on Monday named Sadok Fayala as Secretary of State for Maghreb and African affairs.
- The government considers expanding Monastir's airport.
- Environment Minister Mohamed Mehdi Mlika stressed on Monday the importance of reinforcing cooperation with foreign cities on urban wastes.
- President Ben Ali on Monday asked Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to open on Tuesday a forum on export policy.
